sources.snippet: Ling is a MoE LLM provided and open-sourced by InclusionAI. We introduce two different sizes, which are Ling-lite and Ling-plus. Ling-lite has 16.8 billion parameters with 2.75 billion activated parameters, while Ling-plus has 290 billion parameters with 28.8 billion activated parameters. sources.title: Ling-3.0-tiny · Models
sources.snippet: We are introducing Ling-3.0-tiny, a lightweight hybrid reasoning MoE model with 7.9B total parameters and only 1.3B activated parameters per token. It is designed to deliver strong reasoning and agentic capabilities at low inference cost, making advanced model capabilities more accessible for local and resource-constrained deployment.
